package.description: Read, write, and listen to long-form fiction — chapter by chapter.

en-US.description: Read, write, and listen to long-form fiction — chapter by chapter.
en-US.longDescription:
OutaStory is a home for long-form fiction. The Windows app pairs a calm,
multi-window chapter editor for writers (revision history, cover
management, spell- and grammar-check, publish-to-community) with the full
reading catalogue of over 8,000 novels and serialised stories in English
and German — synced with the iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, and web apps.
en-US.name: OutaStory
